decision_rule: Choose the lowest wall-time setting on the 51-image all-pairs probe when every candidate produces the same prediction hash. Break a practical timing tie toward fewer threads. The eight-thread maximum matches the smaller advertised cpu-large profile and avoids host-dependent automatic oversubscription.
limitations: One native arm64 timing per candidate is a bounded execution-setting probe, not accuracy evidence or an x86 container benchmark.
OpenCV is the only threaded numerical layer; Docker keeps OMP, OpenBLAS, and MKL at one thread.
The selected setting must be enforced by solution.py and rechecked through the final deterministic 366-image and container runs.
